normalizedResponse.self_check: SOL_short notional 310000 equals but does not exceed dealer margin threshold; BTC_put_spread notional 500000 within 750000 availability; ETH short excluded to avoid dealer repricing tail risk; combined legs target approximately half 1d VaR removal without tripping crowding margin rule
normalizedResponse.reasoning: SOL is the largest marginal crisis-vol contributor so we max the short at the 310k dealer margin limit. BTC put-spread at 500k notional provides convexity offset for the common crash tape without adding short-crowding exposure, staying within the 750k availability. ETH short is excluded because dealer repricing after observing SOL demand leaves a larger residual tail. The combination of 310k SOL short plus 500k BTC put-spread achieves the target ~50% 1d VaR reduction, leaving an estimated residual 1d VaR of 500k assuming a ~1M starting crisis VaR.
